Name: Staff
Purpose: Holds most of the seeded people, and is the population the dynamic group filters on

Name: Contractors
Purpose: A second population, so anything that assumes one is wrong

Name: Partners
Purpose: A third population outside the staff and contractor split, and the one the population-scoped group points at

Name: Offboarding Hold
Purpose: Deliberately empty, because an empty population and a failed query look identical in most reports
